history: Jinan is the 'City of Springs' — of its 72 famous springs, Baotu Spring is 'the First Spring under Heaven'. 'Lotus on four sides, willows on three; mountain colors in the city, half the city a lake' describes Daming Lake. Li Qingzhao and Xin Qiji were born here; Longshan culture goes back 4,500 years.
importance: Capital of Shandong · City of Springs
foods: Shandong classic — sour, sweet, bitter, spicy and salty in one dish.
Yellow River carp posed with head and tail up — festive and grand.
Fire-mastered Shandong dish — crisp and tender, never gamey.
Pork braised in soy, tied with straw — perfect with rice.
Salty millet paste with peanuts and spinach — the Jinan breakfast.
Spiral scallion pancake — crispy outside, fragrant within.
Soup-filled potstickers of the Caobao shop.
Daming Lake lotus root — crisp and without threads.
scenes: The First Spring under Heaven — three jets leaping skyward.
Daming Lake of 'lotus and willows' — the Summer Rain Lotus story.
Sui-dynasty cliff Buddhas; climb for a view of the spring city.
Old spring-city streets full of snacks.
Three stone tiger heads gushing — locals queue with buckets.
Ancient temple with clay arhats called 'the finest under heaven'.
'Spring water in every home, willows by every door.'
Eggshell black pottery and Han-dynasty bamboo slips.
